grandparents_cupboard.reason: Flour, baking powder, sugar, orange, oil, apples and golden syrup are all ordinary cupboard and fruit-bowl items.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday, cheap item at any mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: Only a bowl, grater, whisk and frying pan are needed, and fritter-style pancakes are well within a beginner's reach.

works.reason: 200g flour to 250ml liquid plus two grated apples gives a thick, droppable batter that cooks through in 2 to 3 minutes a side, enough for four at breakfast.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers zesting, grating and mixing comfortably, and the thirty-minute total is roughly what mixing and frying a few batches takes.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: Stored apples are what is left in March, and they are grated through the batter and sliced on top, so they are the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and written in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: Half-wholemeal pancakes packed with grated apple and only a little sugar and syrup make a reasonable family breakfast.
